old_problem: The destructive UCE command is non-executable source text, its nBIF field/flag semantics and threshold are undocumented, and reset evidence/recovery for all downstream PCIe paths is undefined.
disposition_reason: The comment is an execution boundary and cannot be removed by analogy with the active CE case. AMD --nbionbif fields and errortype1 are core vendor semantics; immediate reset and boot/I/O recovery are project policy. ED-03/12/16/18 prohibit uncommenting, guessing or forcing reset. Pending/BLOCKED remains until source owner and vendor authority approve the complete contract.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row73, same-row AI/history2473, CE companion and next DF WDT row74.
Preserved the comment marker, nBIF UCE, immediate reset, threshold, multi-OS and downstream-I/O recovery scope.
Did not reuse errortype0 or IOHUB semantics for this separate UCE path.
Required fresh persistent source evidence and OOB timing across reset.
No uncommenting, register change, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: nBIF UCE command-intent, reset and downstream-I/O recovery
test_case.purpose: If owner-approved, inject one authoritative UCE into each mapped nBIF structure, verify the signed reset and fresh durable source evidence, and recover every attached boot, management and data path.
required_package: Signed decision that the commented UCE line is executable or unsupported
Downstream dependency, OOB reimage and exact rollback runbook
test_case.test_command: Keep the line commented. If later authorized, inventory downstream dependencies and persistent records, capture complete raw state, apply only documented changes, execute one verified target once under OOB capture, correlate reset and fresh source evidence, then restore/compare all state and I/O paths.
test_case.expected_result: If unsupported, authoritative N/A evidence preserves the testcase. If supported, the intended nBIF UCE follows the signed reset branch, produces one fresh target-correlated durable record, boots within deadline and restores every dependent PCIe path and RAS control.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS until command and UCE semantics are authoritative. Uncommenting, generic post-boot logs, stale records, wrong source, missing/unexpected reset, boot loop, lost I/O or imperfect restoration fails.
safety_gate: Never uncomment without signed source/vendor approval.
Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/console and reimage path.
One target once; abort on wrong source, absent reset, boot loop or persistent device loss.
No automatic retry/reset; preserve durable evidence.
expected_evidence: nBIF/downstream dependency map and raw state
If supported, single transcript and OOB reset/boot timeline
Recovered I/O, restored configuration and verdict
test_case.recovery: No execution is allowed until the runbook covers missing/unexpected reset, boot-loop/reimage escape, all nBIF-connected devices and exact threshold/Platform First/NBIO/FCH/HDT restoration.
